_about: Lane (brain bank or collection) for each single-cell / single-nucleus study, 2026-09-25 (Paul: 'the single-cell studies have to go in the lane for their sources, or near them, and link up to the consortium nodes'). Keys are the sc node keys (PMID or DOI). lane: lineage lane key; banks: lane keys when subjects come from two or more lanes (tracker Decision: multi-bank studies contribute per-bank lists when separable, else study tier only); bank_names: banks as the paper names them; evidence: where read. edges: data re-use and subject links to consortium nodes (coll:*) or corpus studies, kinds per the tracker Vocabulary. Read by build_lineage.py; lane_overrides.json is applied after it.
